summary: Nora's Discord handle in <presence> is now read live from the bridge, the same way Instagram's already is, instead of only a declared config value.
details: The Discord adapter already calls GET /users/@me once at startup to resolve her own id; that same response's username and discriminator are now cached and reused to render her Discord handle every turn, with no extra network call.
Rendered @username#discriminator when Discord still assigns a numbered tag, or @username alone once the account is on Discord's migrated unique usernames (discriminator "0").
[agent.handles] discord stays as the declared fallback for a deployment whose adapter has not resolved yet; the live read wins whenever it has one.
limitations: The username remains display text only: it is never one of her matchable identifiers and never enters self_aliases(), same as every other platform's no-username rule.
